---
date: 2026-09-25
service: github
service_version: 1
status: active
distributable: true
---
## Root cause
The repository view command was run with no argument, so it showed the repository in the current directory instead of the target project.
## Fix
Run the view command with an explicit owner/repository argument, as in the documented example: gh repo view owner/repo.

success_evidence.action: Ran the view command with an explicit owner/repository argument
success_evidence.outcome: The target repository's description and README were displayed instead of the current directory's repository

---
date: 2026-09-25
service: github
service_version: 1
status: active
distributable: true
---
## Root cause
The request named an API version that is no longer supported in the X-GitHub-Api-Version header, so it received a 410 Gone response.
## Fix
Specify a supported API version with the X-GitHub-Api-Version header, as in the documented example X-GitHub-Api-Version:2026-03-10.

success_evidence.action: Resent the request with the header X-GitHub-Api-Version:2026-03-10 as in the documented curl example
success_evidence.outcome: The request no longer received 410 Gone and the endpoint returned its normal response

## Root cause
The inventory listed repositories without passing an owner, so the output did not correspond to the organization under review.
## Fix
Run the list command with the owner as the argument; the documented command lists repositories owned by a user or organization and only includes repositories owned by the provided argument.

success_evidence.action: Ran the list command with the organization as the owner argument
success_evidence.outcome: Only repositories owned by that organization were listed

## Root cause
A change was planned against an archived repository, where content becomes read-only.
## Fix
Check the archived state first; to make changes in an archived repository, it must be unarchived first.

success_evidence.action: Checked the archived state of the repository before planning the change
success_evidence.outcome: The repository was shown as archived, and the plan was moved to a live repository instead
